svg.title: SIRAJ derived-field lineage
svg.text: Where the calculated fields come from (ƒ)
Every derived field is a SQL expression over the tables named on its right; nothing is stored, which is why all of them can be filtered, sorted, exported and charted.
Derived fields are published by /api/meta together with their SQL expression, so a client can show the formula and an auditor can check it without reading the code.
